section: Step 1: See How Your Server Looks to Users
build: packages/cli/dist built with npm run build from commit 7506588f
invocation: node packages/cli/dist/index.js mcp audit, run with a new empty HOME (a path with no symlink in it, so the CLI shortens the config path to ~) from HOME/mcp-server-tools
setup: HOME/mcp-server-tools: package.json (@myorg/mcp-server-tools 1.2.0), dist/index.js and a .mcp.json configuring my-server (node ./dist/index.js), filesystem (npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .), postgres (npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres) and github (npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github); `opena2a mcp sign my-server` from Step 2 was run once before the audit, so my-server holds a signature and the other three do not
network: online: the three npm-package servers were looked up in the OpenA2A Registry, and the trust endings are the answers it gave at capture time
stream: stdout; stderr was empty on this run
